title: Pollution forecasts are checked against three regional station networks
summary: AirMPA’s learned meteorology-to-pollution forecasts were evaluated against monitoring stations in China, Europe and the United States. The study reports lower particulate-matter prediction error than CAMS and Aurora. This retrospective field-reference evaluation does not establish operational warning or health benefits.
ai_technology: Swin Transformer; AirMPA; FuXi-2.0 meteorological forecasts
organization: Fudan University; Shanghai Academy of AI for Science; University of Shanghai for Science and Technology

evidence.tested: June–November2022 retrospective station comparisons supplemented gridded-reference tests; learned pollutant evolution used forecast meteorology during inference.
evidence.unknown: Development validation used 2023, later than the test period. Training references incorporate model outputs and satellite observations. Station matching details and site-level uncertainty were not independently reconciled. Resolution, empirical emissions and extreme-event underestimation limit transfer.
evidence.ai_role: The Transformer learns pollutant evolution from meteorological, emissions and recent-concentration fields.

source_review.scope: Primary v1 architecture, training/evaluation partition, station Results/Figure10 description and limitations; exact current version/history.
